signals: Global Talent routes exist for researchers and academics.
Current or recent individual fellowship history can be relevant; exact fellowship eligibility must be re-verified at decision time.
Employer sponsorship being unavailable is not an automatic blocker because an independent Global Talent route may exist.
Research and highly skilled migrant routes rely on recognised sponsors.
Recognised sponsor status can be checked in IND public registers.
Academic and research immigration is generally viable but route details are role-specific and must be current-verified.
Scientific researchers may use an accredited research organisation Hosting Agreement route.
Researcher and postdoctoral routes can involve a hosting agreement and single permit; exact national implementation must be current-verified.
Researcher talent-passport routes use a hosting agreement with an approved research/higher-education institution.
Researcher residence routes use an admission/hosting agreement with an eligible research institution.
Employer-sponsored temporary and permanent skilled routes exist.
Academic and researcher nominations have specific rules or exemptions in some employer-nominated routes.
Employer willingness is decisive for many vacancies.

anti_rules: Do not convert sponsorship silence into rejection.
Do not fold mobility into scientific-fit scoring.
Do not assume a historic immigration rule remains current; verify time-sensitive details before final mobility rejection.
